title: DOCS: Product Hunt updates
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

**Base branch set to `master`.**

This PR contains the following updates:

- removes the Product Hunt badge from the [homepage](https://mermaid.js.org/)
- updates the Product Hunt badge on the [Mermaid Chart](https://mermaid.js.org/ecosystem/mermaid-chart.html) page

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Design decisions made by the Mermaid Chart team.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html)
- [ ] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [ ] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html#update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [ ] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
